parts.geometry: box with four legs and openings for drawers and doors

active_constraints.directional: The cabinet body rests stationary on the ground surface, resisting vertical displacement through ground contact.
active_constraints.material: Solid teak or oak wood construction provides structural rigidity to support all mounted components.
active_constraints.internal_volume: The cabinet body encloses storage compartments accessed via doors and drawers.
active_constraints.safety: The cabinet must remain stable and not tip over during interaction with doors and drawers.

invalid_behaviors: ROTATIONAL — the cabinet body is a fixed base structure and does not rotate
LINEAR_TRANSLATIONAL — the cabinet is not designed to slide or translate during normal use
DEFORMATION — solid wood construction resists deformation under normal loads

active_constraints.material: The top panel is solid wood, providing a flat durable surface for placing items.
active_constraints.contact_friction: Surface friction keeps placed items from sliding off under normal conditions.
active_constraints.safety: The top panel must support the weight of items placed on it without bowing or breaking.

invalid_behaviors: ROTATIONAL — the top panel is fixed to the cabinet body
LINEAR_TRANSLATIONAL — the top panel does not slide or translate
DEFORMATION — solid wood top resists deformation under normal use loads

active_constraints.directional: The left drawer translates linearly along the forward-backward axis only.
active_constraints.range_limits: The drawer extends to a maximum stop and cannot be pulled beyond full extension or pushed past flush closed position.
active_constraints.clearance: The drawer requires clearance in front of the cabinet to fully open without obstruction.
active_constraints.contact_friction: Drawer slides on wooden or metal runners creating friction that holds it in partially open positions.
active_constraints.internal_volume: The drawer provides enclosed storage volume accessible only when pulled open.
active_constraints.kinematic_chain: The drawer handle initiates the pull force that translates through the drawer face to the drawer box.

invalid_behaviors: ROTATIONAL — drawers translate linearly and do not rotate
DEFORMATION — the rigid wood drawer does not deform during operation

active_constraints.directional: The left door swings outward around a vertical hinge axis on its left edge.
